title: Frantz v. Cantrell — implicit goods analysis
shortTitle: Frantz v. Cantrell — implicit goods analysis
summary: The editors describe Article 2 reasoning about shingles in a roof-installation transaction.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The example illustrates that courts sometimes analyze the goods-related complaint without expressly discussing the broader service-dominant contract. It should not be treated as an express adoption of a fully articulated gravamen test.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 249–250. Open assigned page 249.
